experiments.claim: Matched-scale direct training can reach the same task quality at a lower actual rate
experiments.primary: rank 1/4/16, alpha/r=2, identical examples, updates and seeds; actual byte minima at fixed absolute task accuracy

experiments.claim: The trained teacher function can be recoded more cheaply than its original factorization
experiments.primary: rank-1 hard distillation from rank-16/64 teachers versus rank-1 oracle training; task accuracy and exact teacher agreement kept separate

experiments.claim: Codec costs and useful function costs can separate
experiments.primary: rank by precision surface with power-of-two gauge controls, selected on development only and verified once on held-out company/year questions

analysis: Report achieved distortion and censored thresholds for every arm. The code length is an achievable upper bound, not a minimum over all programs. Teacher agreement refers to deterministic complete normalized answers, not KL. A gauge transform must preserve raw predictions. Two student seeds and both families are blocked comparisons. No test-based selection or receiver intercept.
